confidence_rationale: The only source in the artificial-agents domain that meets BOTH of GOV-CONTRACT-1's admissibility tests for that domain: the controllable-part-of-the-observation variable is discovered without being specified (an attention model trained only to predict the agent's own action localises the agent sprite), and lacking it produces the characteristic failure (sparse-reward exploration collapses). Held at 0.6 because 'controllable' is defined relative to a discrete action set, i.e. relative to a body, so the embodied reading is not excluded, and because agent-localisation is self-vs-world in a spatial sense only.
failure_signatures: Baselines without the discovered agent-location context fail Montezuma's Revenge; the agent that cannot separate what it controls from what merely changes cannot learn to act -- MECH-545's 'poor action learning' signature.

Emergent-communication work (Lipinski et al. 2023; Chaabouni et al. 2020) shows that task pressure alone does NOT reliably force a separably encoded relation into a channel, so emergence in one architecture is not evidence that any unified system must carry the variable.

mapping.source_claim_statement: A self-supervised attentive dynamics model trained only to predict the agent's action from consecutive frames discovers the controllable part of the observation (in Atari, the character's location); using that as context for count-based exploration achieves over 11,000 on Montezuma's Revenge without demonstrations or privileged information.
mapping.ree_translation: GOV-CONTRACT-1 domain 5 asks whether independently trained agents discover an analogous variable without it being specified and whether its removal produces characteristic failure. Both hold here for the CONTROLLABILITY half of the AGENCY candidate. Thomas et al. 2017 (Independently Controllable Factors) makes the same variable the organising signal for representation learning. Together with MECH-256's comparator lineage this is the artificial-agent cousin of corollary discharge: the system learns which changes are its own.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Controllability is defined against a body (an action set) and a single game family drives the headline number; internal/external attribution for non-spatial events is untested. The emergence is in one architecture under one objective, not a demonstration that every unified system must carry the variable.
mapping.source_context: Deep RL, Atari (Montezuma's Revenge, Venture), self-supervised inverse-dynamics attention model.

confidence_components.notes: Domain 5 (artificial agents) anchor for AGENCY; the one cell in that domain where emergence AND ablation are both met.
